text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Whoa...! What amazing decorations!
choice_data_list:
Christmas is right around the corner, 
after all.

Christmas is right around the corner, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ah, is it that time of year already?! Man, 
a year really goes by in a flash...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, a Santa snowman! I wonder who made 
it?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Christmas has so many sparkly, wonderful 
things, doesn't it? Hehe♪

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Huh?! No way!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Um, don't worry! Put together a rigorous 
menu for me just like always!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Actually, that's what I want you to do.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...You're not going to laugh?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Back when I attended a junior club, we 
had an event race on Christmas."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I was in top condition up until that day, 
you know? So many people were cheering for 
me... Even I was completely sure I'd win!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Still... for the first time in my life, I 
missed the board.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...And around this time of year, unless 
I'm training with everything I've got, I 
get a little anxious...
choice_data_list: You must've been reaaally frustrated, huh.

You must've been reaaally frustrated, 
weren't you.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. So very much...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I was soooo......oooo frustrated!! So, so 
much...!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
And you know what?! I'm still thinking 
about why I lost!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Because I really, really wanted to win! I 
really, truly tried my very, very 
hardest!!"
choice_data_list: ...Did you run out of breath at the end?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, that's right...—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, do you happen to know why I 
lost?! Sensei said the distance might not 
have suited me, though.
choice_data_list:
Maybe your "desire to win" was just too 
strong.

Maybe your "desire to win" was just too 
strong.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe... that's why? I was rushing 
ahead of myself emotionally, so I made my 
move way too early...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...*gasp*! I really haven't changed at 
all...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yes, just a little bit!

Even so, it seems she hasn't managed to 
completely wipe away the memories.

It'd be such a waste to let bad feelings 
linger on Christmas of all days.
choice_data_list:
(In that case... let's rewrite the record 
books!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Merry Christmas! Thank you for 
inviting me today!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'll come! I worked so hard 
adjusting my schedule just to keep today 
open!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I'm in top condition... and 
I don't have a single worry!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...I understand how you feel. Today, 
we're going to enjoy ourselves to the 
fullest!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Wah...! It's so lively!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, so many little trinkets! And... it 
smells so nice too!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"This is cinnamon! —It's a limited-edition 
Christmas drink!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Ah! T-Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: There's a Kyumaru Santa...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
W-What should I do?! A ph-photo... Ah, but 
a two-shot too—
choice_data_list:
Let's get someone to take our picture! 
Line up, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Um, Type 90! I mean, Type 90-san! I-I...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ugh, Trainer!
choice_data_list: ...This girl is a huge fan of yours!
...This girl is a huge fan of yours!

text_block_list.name: Q-Maru
text_block_list.text: (Staaare... ...*nod*!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh! I love you so much, Kyu-maru...!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, can you hear me!? Choose!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
A soft one, a sharp one, and a slightly 
futuristic one! Which should it be? Please 
tell me right now~!
choice_data_list: It's set slightly in the future.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ta-da!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks! It's Christmas, so I wanted 
to dress up a bit♪

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
We're still hanging out, right? Where are 
you taking me next?
choice_data_list:
Then let's head somewhere that suits that 
dress—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Whoa...! What a cute kitchen!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Still, why here of all places?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: We will now be serving Christmas dinner!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ooooh!!
choice_data_list: Princess, please have a seat and wait.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Oh, my...! Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Still... Chef! I'll help make it too!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Because that way, it feels much more like 
us!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Haaah... That was so much fun!
choice_data_list: Were you able to overwrite those memories?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Sharp and poised♪

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, right?! You gotta dress to the 
nines for Christmas!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Alright! We're still hanging out, right? 
What are we doing next?
choice_data_list:
Then let's head somewhere that suits that 
outfit—

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Merry Christmas, Ai-chan! Welcome to the 
Christmas party!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Trainer, these kids are...
choice_data_list: Those are the girls who invited you.
They're the girls who invited you.

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
You know, I sent a card to Ai-chan. And 
she replied! Ai-chan is here~!

text_block_list.name: Child B
text_block_list.text:
"Ai-chan, let's race! I'm gonna run just 
like you, Ai-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Challenging me, are we? You've got 
guts!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I won't go easy on you! Rawr~♪

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Haaah... That was so much fun!
choice_data_list: Were you able to overwrite those memories?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I wonder...?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Really? Thank goodness... I was aiming 
for... a slightly future version of me!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
We still have plenty of plans left, right? 
Where shall we head next?
choice_data_list:
Then let's head somewhere that suits that 
dress—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Wah, what a wonderful restaurant...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. But are you sure I'm 
the right one?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm really not used to places like this, 
so...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, today, I'm gonna lean on 
you, my mature Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Haaah... That was so much fun!
choice_data_list: Were you able to overwrite those memories?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course! I feel absolutely 
incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
From now on, I will look back on today. 
Thank you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...It really feels like when I won. My 
heart just won't stop pounding."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
The fact that I lost, and the memories of 
it, won't disappear. However... I have you 
with me.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
You're here to lead me to my next victory! 
So—I'll always be just fine!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Hey, next year... will you overwrite this 
with even happier memories?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Thank you! For my sake—please don't lose!
